mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 for 2 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (>0.5pp over 3 months) signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and S&P 500 earnings, driving negative returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises >0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and weigh on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) decline by >10% year-over-year for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening housing market that will drag on consumer spending and S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST declines >10% y-o-y for 2 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (proxied by PAYEMS) declines for three consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS declines for 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales (proxied by RSAFS) grow by >5% year-over-year for three consecutive months, it signals strong consumer demand that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS grows >5% y-o-y for 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (proxied by CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% for two consecutive months, it signals rising inflationary pressures that will prompt the Fed to tighten monetary policy, weighing on S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% for 2 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive >60% of the time.
